preconditions.description: The grid size n is an integer between 2 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= 3 for a in alice_colors)
preconditions.description: Alice's color choices are integers between 1 and 3 inclusive.
Alice provides exactly n² color choices, one per turn.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n for i, j in placed_cells)
preconditions.description: Placed cells (i, j) are within the grid bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(b != a for a, b in zip(alice_colors, bob_colors))
preconditions.description: Bob's chosen color b is always different from Alice's color a.

preconditions.expression: all((i, j) not in placed_cells for i, j in new_placed_cells)
preconditions.description: Bob places a token only in an empty cell.

postconditions.expression: not any((i1, j1) in placed_cells and (i2, j2) in placed_cells and abs(i1 - i2) + abs(j1 - j2) == 1 and colors[(i1, j1)] == colors[(i2, j2)] for (i1, j1), (i2, j2) in itertools.combinations(placed_cells, 2))
postconditions.description: No two adjacent cells contain tokens of the same color after all turns.
The grid is completely filled after n² turns.
